description:
External render:
Re‑rendering the existing pebble‑dash external walls with a silicone render and painting them white, retaining the same colour and overall appearance. No external insulation is proposed. The works are intended as maintenance and improvement of the existing finish.

Front gate relocation:
Relocating the existing front gate within the front boundary wall from the left‑hand side to the right‑hand side of the property (as described when standing at the front door with back to the house and facing the street). The gate height and width will remain unchanged. The relocation is to improve access and avoid nuisance caused by a nearby bus stop and public bin.

Side gate adjustment:
Repositioning the existing side gate slightly forward within the side boundary to enhance security. The gate height and width will remain unchanged and aligned with neighbour side entrance gate.

Paving around the house:
Laying new paving around the property to replace the existing uneven concrete surface. Paving will be installed below the damp‑proof course level and all existing access points to the property will remain clear and unobstructed.
